features: POWERFUL SOUND: Delivers an impressive 550W RMS output that fills your room with rich, loud, and immersive audio, making movies, music, and gaming feel more engaging.
CINEMATIC AUDIO EXPERIENCE: Powered by Dolby Atmos and DTS X, the system enhances clarity, depth, and realism so dialogues sound sharper and effects feel more lifelike.

SURROUND SOUND SETUP: A true 5.1 channel layout with a triple-driver soundbar, wireless rear satellites (*interconnected with a cable and powered using a single DC adapter), and a 13.33 cm wireless subwoofer creates sound from all directions.
DEEP BASS PERFORMANCE: The wireless subwoofer delivers strong, punchy bass that adds impact to action scenes, music beats, and cinematic moments.
FLEXIBLE CONNECTIVITY: Supports Bluetooth v5.3, HDMI eARC, Optical IN, AUX, and USB, making it easy to connect TVs, gaming consoles, laptops, and media devices.
